summary.text: Alex Joers is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 81 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Mark Maier.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey he listed education, the environment and the economy among his campaign's key messages.

paragraphs.text: Alex Joers was born in Madison, Wisconsin, graduated from Middleton High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse in 2015.
Ballotpedia lists his affiliations as including the New Leaders Council and the Young Elected Officials Network.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Joers said he began working at his family's small business, The Little Gym, at age 14, was elected to the Dane County Board in 2020 and re-elected in 2022, and has served in the Assembly since 2023.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Colleges and Universities, Rules, Small Business Development, and Tourism.

In the same survey, Joers said his campaign priorities include investing in education from childcare through college, restarting the Knowles-Nelson Stewardship Fund, and building an economy that raises wages and supports small business creation.
He also named paid leave and childcare among his priorities for the next term.
